'''Mudflow''' is a [[Common enemy]] in ''[[Arknights: Endfield]]''.

{{Enemy description|The "Tholeroygran" (archive ID: ACM311) is the first fluid-based pattern to be discovered. The morphology of the halo is unstable and the internal temperature is typically lower than its constituent materials.}}

==Overview==
As one of the basic melee [[Aggeloi]], Mudflows are slightly more threatening to [[Ram]]s, but it doesn't make them more of the threat; Besides capable of dashing and ram, which deals Cryo damage and {{G|Cryo Infliction}}, they can also flatten themselves, dealing Cryo damage and {{G|Cryo Infliction}} to Operators around.
